ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels (dark charcoal/black) with approximately 5-8% high-intensity white/grey markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dark base pigmentation across both lobes. A distinct high-contrast white vertical linear feature is present on the mid-left lobe. Several high-contrast white circular/ring-shaped clusters (rosettes) are distributed on both lobes, with a dense grouping adjacent to the vertical line on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated interior angle of approximately 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serration across the inner trailing edges. The right lobe tip displays a high-amplitude, irregular jagged contour with a prominent step-like indentation at the distal terminus.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature along the leading edges, originating from the peduncle and tapering to acute points at the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical high-contrast white line on the left lobe; multiple faint, horizontally-aligned light grey linear scratches traversing the central regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive textured yellowish-brown barnacle colonization clusters along the leading edges and lobe tips; notable irregular tissue loss or jagged deformity at the terminal edge of the right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The combination of the specific vertical scar line and the adjacent rosette cluster on the left lobe forms a unique geometric signature.
